bound_model.guarantee_scope: Finite-sample marginal coverage within each fixed denoise segment under exchangeability; not distribution-free pointwise conditional coverage in z.

holdout_cohort.relationship_to_calibration: Prospectively authored prompts with zero exact overlap with the Gate A or Gate B development cohorts; no holdout images or labels were inspected before this protocol was frozen.

measurement.anchor_signal: z_c = ||Taylor(v_a,v_b;c)-v_c|| / ||v_c|| at each actual A12 anchor c followed by skips
measurement.shadow_semantics: At each A12 skip, evaluate full DiT on the identical pre-step cached latent, retain scalar L2 summaries, and advance the original cached prediction.

secondary_diagnostics.z_quartile_coverage: Report only; no distribution-free conditional-coverage claim.
secondary_diagnostics.category_coverage: Report only; each category has six prompts and is underpowered as a gate.
secondary_diagnostics.association: Secondary because Gate B already established association.

decision_rule.pass: Authorize a new, separately frozen dynamic-policy experiment restricted to actions with labels supported by the measurement schedule.
decision_rule.fail: Do not tune this bound on the holdout. Diagnose the failure and require a new development cohort before changing the family or thresholds.

claims_excluded: pointwise conditional coverage for every z
safe skipping beyond the labeled next A12 segment
